task.title: Resolve profile name errors
task.shortdesc: Fix an empty, duplicate, or unclear profile name during creation or duplicate preparation.

prereq.p: A visible BPM status, validation message, browser warning, or failed action indicates that the current workflow cannot safely continue.

context.p: Profile names identify Library rows, editor tabs, comparison choices, imports, and recovery messages, so name validation blocks ambiguous saves.

step.cmd: Read the name validation hint before changing other profile fields.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Enter a non-empty name that distinguishes the profile purpose, Firefox channel, or source file.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: For duplicate preparation, change the suggested source-based name before confirming if it duplicates an existing row.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Submit creation or duplicate preparation again after the name hint clears.

info.note: A name conflict creates no profile. Retry only from the BPM interface; do not change profile data outside the application.

result.p: The saved profile has a unique visible name that can be found later in the Library.

example.title: Current 0.9.6 behavior
example.p: Create and duplicate use atomic preparation: a name, schema, preset, CIS, or conversion error creates no target and does not change the source. Schema, preset, and CIS are read-only. To correct a value, use its owner: Step 2 for URLs/sites, Step 4 for certificates and trust, and Step 6 for extensions; request an explicit conversion preview to change schema.

postreq.p: If the error repeats, stop the workflow and contact support with the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current page.
